session_type.description: SESSION TYPE. Fixed at session start by the schedule. blinded => tab hidden, main log redacted (see TAB-ONLY fields)

tab.description: must agree with session_type: blinded=hidden, tab_visible=visible

arm.description: TAB-ONLY: tab_visible sessions and the sealed log of a blinded session; NEVER in a blinded main log

director_format_id.description: v1.1: id of the output-format slot (DIRECTOR_OUTPUT_FORMAT_TEXT)

director_examples_id.description: v1.1: id of the in-context examples slot

director_assembled_sha8.description: v1.1: sha256[:8] of the final assembled Director system message

models.description: models at session start; v1.5: equal to actor_model / director_model

actor_model.description: v1.5: full Actor model tag at session start (canonical); changes are model_change lines

director_model.description: v1.5: full Director model tag at session start (canonical); changes are model_change lines

input_mode.description: v1.5: fixed for the session (a change = a new session); absent in v1-v1.4 = gaze

pointer_config.description: v1.5, input_mode pointer only: dwell threshold and gap merge in force

interactive.description: v1.5: a control that may be a pointer target; absent = text (never a hover/dwell target)

input_mode.description: v1.5: the session's input mode (the digest's sources); absent = gaze

pointer.description: v1.5, mode pointer only: interactive-AOI pointer evidence

note_id.description: TAB-ONLY: absent in a blinded main log

actor_request_sha256.description: TAB-ONLY: absent in a blinded main log

input_mode.description: v1.5: the session's input mode (the digest's sources); absent = gaze

pointer.description: v1.5, mode pointer only: interactive-AOI pointer evidence
